rv.q: In Maddie, Jack Finney’s clever novel Marion’s Wall has not been given the musical it deserves.
Despite its interesting set-up, the material somehow side steps the meat of the story.

cn.t: Critics find this musical adaptation of Jack Finney's novel about a 1920s starlet's ghost fails to conjure much magic, with both reviewers giving it low marks and suggesting the premise doesn't translate effectively to the stage.
